question: If p ∶ q = 4 ∶ 7 and q ∶ r = 3 ∶ 5, then what is the value of 2p ∶ 3q ∶ 5r ?
solution:
Given:

P ∶ Q = 4 ∶ 7

Q ∶ R = 3 ∶ 5

Concept used:

If P ∶ Q and Q ∶ R are given, then P ∶ Q ∶ R is given by

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5fd6b4cc1e2e24220187e318a7a353c349552af7a9ee457ca0a98994e70d5459.png] 

P ∶ Q ∶ R = (P × Q) ∶ (Q × Q) ∶ (Q × R)

Calculation:

P ∶ Q ∶ R = (3 × 4) ∶ (3 × 7) ∶ (7 × 5)

⇒ P ∶ Q ∶ R = 12 ∶ 21 ∶ 35 

On comparing, we get

P = 12, Q = 21 and R = 35

Now,

2p ∶ 3q ∶ 5r = (2 × 12) ∶ (3 × 21) ∶ (35 × 5)

⇒ 12 ∶ 63: 175

∴ The answer is** ****12 ∶ 63: 175**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3207dc44c2a8182e54836eab653d94b1f92ca0e3eddfc41a912d5195e78f2e8d.png] 

We have to keep the value of Q as 4 and 7, both according to concept. Don't confuse between them.
